```{r}

# Define traits to analyze
traits <- c(
  # Leaf Morphology
  "Dry_mass",      # Leaf dry mass
  "Area_m2",       # Leaf area
  "LMA_g_m2",      # Leaf mass area
  
  # Gas exchange
  "gsw",           # Stomatal conductance
  
  # Photochemistry
  "PS2",           # Quantum efficiency in light (ΦPSII)
  "ETR",           # Electron transport rate
  "Fs",            # Minimum fluorescence in light
  "Fm",            # Maximum fluorescence in light
  
  # Stomatal patterning
  "PL_U",          # Adaxial density (Du)
  "PL_L",          # Abaxial density (Dl)
  "SD_upper",      # Adaxial stomatal density
  "SD_lower",      # Abaxial stomatal density
  "SDR",           # Stomata ratio
  "Ocurrence_upper", # Adaxial stomatal occurrence  (Ou)
  
  # Gas exchange isotopes & Nutrient-use traits
  "d13C",          # Carbon isotopes
  "C",             # Carbon content
  "d15N",          # Nitrogen isotopes
  "N",             # Nitrogen content
  "CN"             # Carbon:nitrogen ratio
)


# Set output PDF file for histograms
pdf("Scripts and Data/Q1_GeneticVariation_Plasticity/Histogram_traits_2022.pdf", 
    width = 18, height = 10)

# Initialize list to store individual plots
plot_list <- list()

# Loop through each trait and generate histogram
for (variable in traits) {
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = !!sym(variable), color = GARDEN)) +
    geom_histogram(fill = "white", bins = 30) +  # You can adjust bins as needed
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = variable, y = "Count") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "left",
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  
  plot_list[[variable]] <- p
}

# Arrange plots in a grid and save to PDF
grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list, ncol = 5)

# Close the PDF device
dev.off()
```

#Q1 To what extent do physiological traits exhibit genetic variation in plasticity across environments? 

##Partition phenotypic variance into genotype, environment, and G×E
```{r}

set.seed(123)
# FORMAT VARIABLES

df$Genotype <- as.factor(df$PLANT_ID)
df$Environment <- as.factor(df$GARDEN)
df$mblock <- as.factor(df$mblock)


# Binary trait analyzed separately
traits_cont <- traits[traits != "Ocurrence_upper"]

n_boot <- 1000 # Number of bootstrap replicates
bootstrap_results <- list()


# LOOP THROUGH CONTINUOUS TRAITS


for (trait in traits_cont) {
  
  message("Analyzing trait: ", trait)
  
  # Prepare trait-specific dataset

  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[trait]]),
      !is.na(Genotype),
      !is.na(Environment),
      !is.na(mblock)
    )
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) < 10) next
  
  # Get unique genotypes

  genotypes <- unique(df_sub$Genotype)
  n_genotypes <- length(genotypes)
  
  trait_boot <- list()
  

  # BOOTSTRAP LOOP

  for (b in 1:n_boot) {
    
    if (b %% 100 == 0) {
      message("  Bootstrap ", b, " / ", n_boot)
    }
    

    # Sample genotypes with replacement

    sampled_genotypes <- sample(
      genotypes,
      size = n_genotypes,
      replace = TRUE
    )
    

    # Build bootstrap dataset

    boot_dat_list <- list()
    
    for (j in seq_along(sampled_genotypes)) {
      
      g <- sampled_genotypes[j]
      
      temp <- df_sub[df_sub$Genotype == g, ]
      
      # Give each bootstrap draw a unique genotype ID
      temp$Genotype_boot <- paste0("boot_", j)
      
      boot_dat_list[[j]] <- temp
    }
    
    boot_dat <- bind_rows(boot_dat_list)
    
    boot_dat$Genotype_boot <- factor(boot_dat$Genotype_boot)
    boot_dat$Environment <- factor(boot_dat$Environment)
    boot_dat$mblock <- factor(boot_dat$mblock)
    

    # Fit bootstrap model

    
    formula_boot <- as.formula(
      paste0(
        trait,
        " ~ 1 + ",
        "(1|Genotype_boot) + ",
        "(1|Environment) + ",
        "(1|Genotype_boot:Environment) + ",
        "(1|mblock)"
      )
    )
    
    model_boot <- tryCatch(
      lmer(
        formula_boot,
        data = boot_dat,
        REML = TRUE,
        control = lmerControl(
          optimizer = "bobyqa",
          optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
        )
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    if (is.null(model_boot)) next
    

    # Extract variance components

    vc_boot <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_boot))
    
    boot_genotype <- vc_boot$vcov[
      vc_boot$grp == "Genotype_boot"
    ]
    
    boot_environment <- vc_boot$vcov[
      vc_boot$grp == "Environment"
    ]
    
    boot_gxe <- vc_boot$vcov[
      vc_boot$grp == "Genotype_boot:Environment"
    ]
    
    boot_block <- vc_boot$vcov[
      vc_boot$grp == "mblock"
    ]
    
    boot_residual <- vc_boot$vcov[
      vc_boot$grp == "Residual"
    ]
    
    # Skip bootstrap replicate if component is missing
    if (
      length(boot_genotype) == 0 ||
      length(boot_environment) == 0 ||
      length(boot_gxe) == 0 ||
      length(boot_block) == 0 ||
      length(boot_residual) == 0
    ) {
      next
    }
    

    # Total variance

    boot_total <- (
      boot_genotype +
      boot_environment +
      boot_gxe +
      boot_block +
      boot_residual
    )
    
    # Save bootstrap replicate

    trait_boot[[b]] <- data.frame(
      Trait = trait,
      Bootstrap = b,
      
      Genotype_vcov = boot_genotype,
      Environment_vcov = boot_environment,
      GxE_vcov = boot_gxe,
      block_vcov = boot_block,
      Residual_vcov = boot_residual,
      
      Genotype_prop = boot_genotype / boot_total * 100,
      Environment_prop = boot_environment / boot_total * 100,
      GxE_prop = boot_gxe / boot_total * 100,
      block_prop = boot_block / boot_total * 100,
      Residual_prop = boot_residual / boot_total * 100
    )
  }
  
  bootstrap_results[[trait]] <- bind_rows(trait_boot)
}


# COMBINE ALL BOOTSTRAP RESULTS

bootstrap_results_df <- bind_rows(bootstrap_results)

# BOOTSTRAP MEANS + 95% CONFIDENCE INTERVALS

final_results <- bootstrap_results_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    
    Genotype_mean = mean(Genotype_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    Genotype_lower = quantile(Genotype_prop, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    Genotype_upper = quantile(Genotype_prop, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    Environment_mean = mean(Environment_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    Environment_lower = quantile(Environment_prop, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    Environment_upper = quantile(Environment_prop, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    GxE_mean = mean(GxE_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    GxE_lower = quantile(GxE_prop, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    GxE_upper = quantile(GxE_prop, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    block_mean = mean(block_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    block_lower = quantile(block_prop, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    block_upper = quantile(block_prop, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    Residual_mean = mean(Residual_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    Residual_lower = quantile(Residual_prop, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    Residual_upper = quantile(Residual_prop, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    n_successful_boot = n(),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ round(.x, 2)
    )
  )

# VIEW RESULTS
print(final_results)
#write.csv(final_results, "final_results.csv")
```

```{r}
# BOOTSTRAP VARIANCE PARTITIONING FOR OCCURRENCE_UPPER

set.seed(123)

n_boot <- 1000


# Prepare data

df_occur <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Ocurrence_upper),
    !is.na(Genotype),
    !is.na(Environment),
    !is.na(mblock)
  )

df_occur$Genotype <- factor(df_occur$Genotype)
df_occur$Environment <- factor(df_occur$Environment)
df_occur$mblock <- factor(df_occur$mblock)

# Unique genotypes
genotypes <- unique(df_occur$Genotype)
n_genotypes <- length(genotypes)

# Empty list
occur_boot <- list()


# Bootstrap

for (b in 1:n_boot) {
  
  if (b %% 100 == 0) {
    message("Bootstrap ", b, " / ", n_boot)
  }
  
  # Sample genotypes with replacement
  sampled_genotypes <- sample(
    genotypes,
    size = n_genotypes,
    replace = TRUE
  )
  
  # Build bootstrap dataset
  boot_dat_list <- list()
  
  for (j in seq_along(sampled_genotypes)) {
    
    g <- sampled_genotypes[j]
    
    temp <- df_occur[df_occur$Genotype == g, ]
    
    # Unique ID for each bootstrap draw
    temp$Genotype_boot <- paste0("boot_", j)
    
    boot_dat_list[[j]] <- temp
  }
  
  boot_dat <- bind_rows(boot_dat_list)
  
  boot_dat$Genotype_boot <- factor(boot_dat$Genotype_boot)
  boot_dat$Environment <- factor(boot_dat$Environment)
  boot_dat$mblock <- factor(boot_dat$mblock)
  

  # Fit binomial GLMM
  model_boot <- tryCatch(
    
    glmer(
      Ocurrence_upper ~
        1 +
        (1 | Genotype_boot) +
        (1 | Environment) +
        (1 | Genotype_boot:Environment) +
        (1 | mblock),
      
      data = boot_dat,
      family = binomial,
      
      control = glmerControl(
        optimizer = "bobyqa",
        optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
      )
    ),
    
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(model_boot)) next
  
  # Extract variance components

  vc_boot <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_boot))
  
  var_genotype <- vc_boot$vcov[
    vc_boot$grp == "Genotype_boot"
  ]
  
  var_environment <- vc_boot$vcov[
    vc_boot$grp == "Environment"
  ]
  
  var_gxe <- vc_boot$vcov[
    vc_boot$grp == "Genotype_boot:Environment"
  ]
  
  var_block <- vc_boot$vcov[
    vc_boot$grp == "mblock"
  ]
  
  # Skip failed replicate
  if (
    length(var_genotype) == 0 ||
    length(var_environment) == 0 ||
    length(var_gxe) == 0 ||
    length(var_block) == 0
  ) {
    next
  }
  
  # Residual variance for binomial-logit model

  var_residual <- (pi^2) / 3
  
  # Total variance
  total_var <- (
    var_genotype +
    var_environment +
    var_gxe +
    var_block +
    var_residual
  )
  

  # Save each bootstrap replicate
  occur_boot[[b]] <- data.frame(
    
    Trait = "Ocurrence_upper",
    Bootstrap = b,
    
    Genotype_prop = var_genotype / total_var * 100,
    Environment_prop = var_environment / total_var * 100,
    GxE_prop = var_gxe / total_var * 100,
    block_prop = var_block / total_var * 100,
    Residual_prop = var_residual / total_var * 100
  )
}

# Combine bootstrap replicates

occur_boot_df <- bind_rows(occur_boot)

# Bootstrap mean + 95% CI

occur_final <- occur_boot_df %>%
  summarise(
    
    Genotype_mean = mean(Genotype_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    Genotype_lower = quantile(Genotype_prop, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    Genotype_upper = quantile(Genotype_prop, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    Environment_mean = mean(Environment_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    Environment_lower = quantile(Environment_prop, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    Environment_upper = quantile(Environment_prop, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    GxE_mean = mean(GxE_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    GxE_lower = quantile(GxE_prop, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    GxE_upper = quantile(GxE_prop, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    block_mean = mean(block_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    block_lower = quantile(block_prop, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    block_upper = quantile(block_prop, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    Residual_mean = mean(Residual_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
    Residual_lower = quantile(Residual_prop, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    Residual_upper = quantile(Residual_prop, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    n_successful_boot = n()
    
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Trait = "Ocurrence_upper",
    .before = 1
  )

# Round
occur_final <- occur_final %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))
  )

print(occur_final)
```

#AIC-based model comparison for G × E effects 
```{r}
traits3 <- c(
  "Dry_mass", "Area_m2", "LMA_g_m2", "gsw",
  "PS2", "ETR", "Fs", "Fm",
  "PL_U", "PL_L", "SD_upper", "SD_lower", "SDR", 
  "Ocurrence_upper",
  "d13C", "C", "d15N", "N", "CN"
)

models_list <- list()
AIC_results <- list()

for (trait in traits3) {
  
  message("Fitting models for trait: ", trait)
  
  df_sub <- df[!is.na(df[[trait]]), ]
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) < 10) next
  
  
  # Full model: includes G x E
  full_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      trait,
      " ~ 1 + (1|ID) + (1|GARDEN) + ",
      "(1|ID:GARDEN) + (1|mblock)"
    )
  )
  
  # Reduced model: removes G x E
  null_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      trait,
      " ~ 1 + (1|ID) + (1|GARDEN) + (1|mblock)"
    )
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Binary trait
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (trait == "Ocurrence_upper") {
    
    full_model <- tryCatch(
      glmer(
        full_formula,
        data = df_sub,
        family = binomial
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message("FULL MODEL ERROR: ", e$message)
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    null_model <- tryCatch(
      glmer(
        null_formula,
        data = df_sub,
        family = binomial
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message("REDUCED MODEL ERROR: ", e$message)
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Continuous traits
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
    
  } else {
    
    full_model <- tryCatch(
      lmer(
        full_formula,
        data = df_sub,
        REML = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message("FULL MODEL ERROR: ", e$message)
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    null_model <- tryCatch(
      lmer(
        null_formula,
        data = df_sub,
        REML = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message("REDUCED MODEL ERROR: ", e$message)
        NULL
      }
    )
  }
  
  
  if (is.null(full_model) || is.null(null_model)) next
  
  
  # Store models
  models_list[[trait]] <- list(
    full = full_model,
    null = null_model,
    N = nrow(df_sub)
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Compare AIC
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  AIC_full <- AIC(full_model)
  AIC_reduced <- AIC(null_model)
  
  # Positive Delta AIC means full GxE model is better
  delta_AIC <- AIC_reduced - AIC_full
  
  
  AIC_results[[trait]] <- data.frame(
    Trait = trait,
    N = nrow(df_sub),
    AIC_full = AIC_full,
    AIC_reduced = AIC_reduced,
    Delta_AIC = delta_AIC,
    GxE_supported = delta_AIC >= 2
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

AIC_results_df <- do.call(rbind, AIC_results)

rownames(AIC_results_df) <- NULL

AIC_results_df



sig_traits_GxE <- AIC_results_df$Trait[
  AIC_results_df$Delta_AIC >= 2
]

sig_traits_GxE

```


##Q1.1 Estimating broad sense heritability for physiological traits
###Vermont 

```{r}


df_Vermont <- df %>%
  filter(GARDEN == "Vermont")

traits <- c(
  "Dry_mass", "Area_m2", "LMA_g_m2", "gsw", "d13C",
  "PS2", "ETR", "Fs", "Fm",
  "GC_U", "GC_L", "PL_U", "PL_L",
  "SD_upper", "SD_lower", "SDR", "Ocurrence_upper",
  "C", "d15N", "N", "CN"
)

# Number of bootstrap replicates
n_boot <- 1000

set.seed(123)

bootstrap_results_Vermont <- data.frame()

for (trait in traits) {

  cat("Bootstrapping:", trait, "\n")

  # Remove missing values for this trait
  dat_trait <- df_Vermont %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[trait]]),
      !is.na(PLANT_ID),
      !is.na(BLOCK)
    )

  # Unique genotypes
  genotypes <- unique(dat_trait$PLANT_ID)

  boot_H2 <- rep(NA, n_boot)

  for (b in 1:n_boot) {

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Bootstrap PLANT_IDs WITH REPLACEMENT
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    sampled_ids <- sample(
      genotypes,
      size = length(genotypes),
      replace = TRUE
    )

    # Important:
    # duplicated genotypes need NEW genotype IDs in bootstrap
    boot_dat <- bind_rows(
      lapply(seq_along(sampled_ids), function(i) {

        tmp <- dat_trait %>%
          filter(PLANT_ID == sampled_ids[i])

        # Treat repeated draws of same genotype as separate
        # bootstrap clusters
        tmp$BOOT_ID <- paste0("G", i)

        tmp
      })
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Continuous traits
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    if (trait != "Ocurrence_upper") {

      form <- as.formula(
        paste(trait, "~ (1|BOOT_ID) + (1|BLOCK)")
      )

      model <- try(
        lmer(
          form,
          data = boot_dat,
          REML = TRUE
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )

      if (!inherits(model, "try-error")) {

        vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))

        sigma_g <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "BOOT_ID"]
        sigma_b <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "BLOCK"]
        sigma_e <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "Residual"]

        if (
          length(sigma_g) == 1 &&
          length(sigma_b) == 1 &&
          length(sigma_e) == 1
        ) {

          boot_H2[b] <-
            sigma_g /
            (sigma_g + sigma_b + sigma_e)
        }
      }
    }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Binary occurrence trait
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    if (trait == "Ocurrence_upper") {

      model <- try(
        glmer(
          Ocurrence_upper ~
            (1 | BOOT_ID) +
            (1 | BLOCK),
          data = boot_dat,
          family = binomial,
          control = glmerControl(
            optimizer = "bobyqa",
            optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)
          )
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )

      if (!inherits(model, "try-error")) {

        vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))

        sigma_g <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "BOOT_ID"]
        sigma_b <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "BLOCK"]

        # Latent-scale residual variance
        sigma_e <- pi^2 / 3

        if (
          length(sigma_g) == 1 &&
          length(sigma_b) == 1
        ) {

          boot_H2[b] <-
            sigma_g /
            (sigma_g + sigma_b + sigma_e)
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Summarize bootstrap distribution
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  boot_H2_clean <- boot_H2[is.finite(boot_H2)]

  bootstrap_results_Vermont <- bind_rows(
    bootstrap_results_Vermont,
    data.frame(
      Trait = trait,
      H2_boot_mean = mean(boot_H2_clean),
      H2_boot_median = median(boot_H2_clean),
      CI_lower = quantile(
        boot_H2_clean,
        0.025
      ),
      CI_upper = quantile(
        boot_H2_clean,
        0.975
      ),
      N_success = length(boot_H2_clean),
      Garden = "Vermont"
    )
  )
}

bootstrap_results_Vermont


```

```{r}
h2<-read.csv("Scripts and Data/Q1_GeneticVariation_Plasticity/Heritability.csv")


h2_table <- h2 %>%
  mutate(
    
    # Same trait order as variance partitioning
    Trait = factor(trait, levels = traits),
    
    `H² Vermont` = paste0(
      round(Vermont_mean, 2),
      " (",
      round(Vermont_CI_lower, 2),
      "–",
      round(Vermont_CI_upper, 2),
      ")"
    ),
    
    `H² Virginia` = paste0(
      round(Virginia_mean, 2),
      " (",
      round(Virginia_CI_lower, 2),
      "–",
      round(Virginia_CI_upper, 2),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  arrange(Trait) %>%
  
  select(
    Trait,
    `H² Vermont`,
    `H² Virginia`
  )

h2_table
```

#Merge results from variance partitioning and h2

```{r}
df_article <- merge(
  var_part_table,
  h2_table,
  by = "Trait",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

# Force exactly the same order as var_part_table
df_article <- df_article[
  match(var_part_table$Trait, df_article$Trait),
]

write.csv(
  df_article,
  "Scripts and Data/Q1_GeneticVariation_Plasticity/Var_part_h2_article_table.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)



var_part_means <- final_results %>%
  mutate(
    Trait = factor(Trait, levels = traits)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Trait) %>%
  select(
    Trait,
    Genotype = Genotype_mean,
    Environment = Environment_mean,
    `G × E` = GxE_mean,
    Block = block_mean,
    Residual = Residual_mean
  )

h2_means <- h2 %>%
  mutate(
    Trait = factor(trait, levels = traits)
  ) %>%
  arrange(trait) %>%
  select(
    Trait,
    `H² Vermont` = Vermont_mean,
    `H² Virginia` = Virginia_mean
  )

df_article_means <- var_part_means %>%
  left_join(h2_means, by = "Trait")

write.csv(
  df_article_means,
  "Scripts and Data/Q1_GeneticVariation_Plasticity/Var_part_h2_article_table_means.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
